facts.fact: The IPDCP opened its first evaluation and certification session for data protection correspondents (CPD) in Atakpamé on 30 September 2026, with 32 professionals, under law n°2019-014.
facts.system: Loi n°2019-014 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The IPDCP is acting: it ran the first CPD certification session in Atakpamé on 30 September 2026.
The IPDCP launched CPD certification on 30 September 2026, following a June 2026 training of designated correspondents.
